title: 36 Hours in Hamburg
abstract: Where else but this high-low metropolis can you window-shop for Cartier diamond necklaces during the day and slum it with punk rockers at night?

title: 36 Hours in São Paulo
abstract: It may be the ugliest, most dangerous city you’ll ever love.

title: 36 Hours in Riga, Latvia
abstract: With stunning Art Deco architecture, a vibrant night life and varied and inventive restaurants, the city’s Soviet gloom has been replaced with a sense of Baltic optimism.

title: 36 Hours in Nassau, the Bahamas
abstract: Treating it as a humdrum stopover for cruise passengers means missing out on a blend of cosmopolitan and uniquely Bahamian experiences.
